blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — A fire destroyed five houses and damaged one house in Sitio Nangka Ville, Barangay Quiot, Cebu City, affecting 36 individuals on Thursday afternoon, November 5. The Cebu City Department of Social Welfare and Services (DSWS) recorded six affected houses, including five destroyed and one damaged, in its final report as of 3:10 a.m. Seven families occupied these properties.
